verdict.rationale: Svelte's docs show reactive state as plain variables (svelte-docs-5). $derived recomputes values from their dependencies, $effect re-runs when reactive state changes, and $state.raw lets you opt out of deep tracking. The compiler output is described as surgically updating the DOM, which implies only dependent code re-runs. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that only dependent UI code re-executes (fine-grained tracking is implied, not spelled out), and independent hands-on corroboration of update granularity.
